__NOTOC__


The KOBICA 35 BC-1 is a leaf-shutter fixed-lens rangefinder introduced by Daehan Optical (Korea Optical) in 1976.[https://www.much.go.kr/L/HRF8zl4T61.do 대한민국역사박물관 | KOBICA 35BC 카메라] (National Museum of Korean Contemporary History) In some documents and images, it is also referred to as KOBICA 35 BC.
